trigger.title: The Flexible Lane Opens
trigger.body: The first large-load fast lane goes live: loads that accept curtailment connect in under two years. Firm power stops being the only way in.

decoy.name: The SMR wave
decoy.reason: Ironvale Power's orderbook headlines promise firm power by the gigawatt. What actually changes the 2038 market is the large-load rulebook, not reactors.
decoy.tell: Firm Build-out spikes on announcements with no delivered megawatts, while the Reform Docket climbs quarter after quarter. The docket is the signal that moves connections; the orderbook is talk.
